computer mouse-down: press a mouse button

Usage: computer [-c NAME] mouse-down [left|right|middle]

Presses a mouse button at the current position and keeps it down (with move
and mouse-up, for custom drags).

Arguments:
  BUTTON     enum        optional  mouse button (left, right, middle); default left

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  computer move 100 100 && computer mouse-down && computer move 300 300 && computer mouse-up

Where: inside a computer it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen remote (-c NAME)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the computer
